acme-support: Hi team — since ~2026-03-10T14:12Z we're seeing intermittent 403/401 on Private VPC model calls and a gap in audit log delivery for 14:12-14:38 UTC. Also noticed a token billing surge. Attaching a sample response and a tcpdump snippet.

sam: thx. paste sample resp + any trace_id please and how to reproduce from an affected host.

acme-support: trace_id=tr-20260310-b9c2ef sample resp: `{"error":{"code":403,"message":"HSM key_wrap_rejected: origin_ip_mismatch"}}`. Repro is simple from their VM: `openssl s_client -connect inference.private.redwood:443 -servername inference.private.redwood` shows occasional `SSL alert number 40` mid-handshake. Curl they used: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://inference.private.redwood/api/v1/chat -d '{"input":"test"}'` sometimes returns 403.

alex: two main hypotheses: (A) egress to KMS/HSM being proxied/inspected causing SNI/ClientCert rewrite and HSM rejecting origin, (B) middlebox/NAT/conntrack causing TCP resets which produce partial TLS handshakes and retries. Need tcpdump, ip route, conntrack counters, and collector logs.

mina: also will check HSM audit for any keywrap rejects and if any CMK rotation or policy change happened. If HSM shows `origin_ip_mismatch` that's telling.

jordan: deploy-bot — any control-plane or private-proxy changes around 14:00-14:45Z?

deploy-bot: [automated] no control-plane deploys or HSM maintenance during 13:30-15:00 UTC.

sam: asked customer for these: `ip route get <kms-ip>`, `curl --verbose --resolve inference.private.redwood:443:<proxy-ip> ...`, `sudo conntrack -S` and `sudo iptables -L -n -v`. They uploaded: ip route shows kms via 10.0.0.254, iptables has default deny with explicit allow to cloudkms ranges, but conntrack shows high drops and `nf_conntrack: table full` spikes around 14:18Z. tcpdump shows SYN,SYN-ACK then RST from proxy 10.20.5.3 at same times.

infra: also pulled NAT logs — NAT gateway pod restarted at 14:22:17 with oom_kill and came back at 14:24:05. Collector pod logs (`kubectl -n private-audit logs deploy/private-audit-collector --since=2h`) show repeated `tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate` and `kms: keywrap timeout`. aws s3 put attempts failed during restart window.

mina: HSM audit (pulled) shows a flurry of keywrap requests around 14:17-14:25 with several `key_wrap_rejected` events where source IPs did not match expected VPC egress IPs — suggests outbound proxy rewriting or intermittent hairpin routing. No CMK rotation or IAM changes.

alex: customer mentioned they have an inline TLS inspection appliance that does SNI rewriting under high load. That matches. Two parallel failure modes: (1) TLS-inspector rewrites SNI/client certs -> HSM rejects -> 403, (2) conntrack table full + NAT restart -> collector retries -> missing audit logs + billing spike.

sam: asked customer to run quick experiments: (A) bypass TLS inspector for cloudkms and s3 endpoints, (B) temporarily raise conntrack max and increase NAT memory / pod replicas, (C) run `openssl s_client -connect <kms-ip>:443 -servername cloudkms.googleapis.com -showcerts` to capture the full handshake when failing.

acme-support: we bypassed TLS inspection for cloudkms and S3 buckets, bumped conntrack hashsize, and scaled NAT to 3 replicas. After changes: no 403s for 30m, collector delivered missing bundles (uploads resumed at 14:30), and billing spike subsided.

alex: good repro -> root cause linked to inline TLS-inspection appliance + resource exhaustion on NAT/conntrack that triggered retry storms. Action items:
- infra: add conntrack sizing recommendation to Private VPC runbook and monitor alert for `nf_conntrack_drops`
- security: update onboarding checklist to warn about TLS-inspecting appliances and recommend allowlisting KMS/HSM endpoints or using transparent passthrough for those ranges
- ops: add a preflight egress test that verifies connectivity to KMS and S3 during Private VPC provisioning
- billing: flag anomaly charges for reversal pending support investigation (acct-team)

mina: confirm HSM audit shows no unauthorized key ops. Marking HSM clean; rejections were due to origin mismatch.

jordan: also let's capture enhanced tcpdump + `ss -tanp` on customer host during any re-run and enable increased sampling on private-proxy to log TLS alert codes (ClientHello/Alert).

sam: will close after KB is published and customer confirms stable for 24h. Drafting KB guidance now: include conntrack defaults, NAT sizing, and explicit note about TLS inspection breaking origin-based HSM checks and SNI/ClientCert passthrough requirement.

acme-support: thanks — all good here. We'll monitor and report if anything else pops up.

sam: closing thread — trace_id=tr-20260310-b9c2ef. Reopen if recurrence. :white_check_mark:
